title: Build a toolbar
summary: Logo, links and a button on one row, with the button pushed right.
brief: Lay the bar out on a single row: the logo on the left, then the links, and the Sign in button against the right edge.
The three links sit side by side, 16px apart.
hints: The bar and the list both need to lay their children out in a row.
display: flex on .bar and on .links. gap spaces the links.
margin-left: auto on .cta soaks up the free space and pushes it to the end.
solutionNotes: Both the bar and the list are flex rows; flex layouts nest freely. An auto margin on a flex item takes all the free space on that side, so margin-left: auto pushes the button to the end.
